concepts.caption: He thinks he's fully hidden
concepts.title: Best Hide-and-Seek Spot in the Ball Pit. Except His Tail 🫣🐱
concepts.en_line: Perfect hiding spot, perfect plan, one very honest tail.

shots.image: Photorealistic vertical composition, eye-level full-body shot of a fluffy red-and-white bicolor Siberian cat with a long plush coat, bright orange-red classic tabby markings on its back and head, a white chest, white paws and a white muzzle, big round copper eyes, and a big bushy ringed orange tabby tail, standing in the middle of a small indoor ball pit filled with glossy plastic balls in red, yellow, blue and green that reach up to its belly, soft padded pastel walls around the pit, bright cheerful indoor light, the whole cat clearly visible in the center of the frame
shots.motion: Right from the first frame the fluffy red-and-white Siberian cat quickly looks left, then right, ears pointing forward like a sneaky player, then crouches low so the colorful balls rise up to its chin, its copper eyes wide and alert. A few plastic balls roll and shift gently around its body. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same fluffy red-and-white bicolor Siberian cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. Now the cat is hiding deep in the same colorful ball pit: only its head and white front paws peek out on top of the plastic balls, eyes wide and proud, while its big bushy ringed orange tabby tail sticks straight up out of the balls right behind it, plainly visible. Same soft padded pastel walls and bright cheerful light. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the cat's bushy orange tabby tail sways side to side above the colorful balls while the cat's head stays low, its copper eyes darting left and right and its ears twitching, completely sure it is hidden. A couple of plastic balls wobble softly around it. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs tucked under the balls. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: A video of a cat and its owner playing a hide-and-scare game went viral this week, getting 2.6M Instagram views in four days, so playful hide-and-seek cat moments are getting attention right now.
trend.pattern: a cat playing hide-and-seek: shot 1 it gets ready to sneak, shot 2 it hides proudly but its huge tail gives it away; a 'he thinks he's hidden' caption gets people to watch for the reveal

evidence.title: Woman And Her Cat Take Turns Scaring Each Other, And Their Little Game Is Absolutely Hilarious
